claims: Continue continuous cardiac and vital sign monitoring with alarms for hypertension and tachycardia.
Reassess blood pressure and titrate antihypertensive therapy (nicardipine drip, labetalol, metoprolol) to maintain blood pressure within target range, avoiding hypotension.
Monitor and manage alcohol withdrawal symptoms (CIWA-Ar) with symptom-triggered benzodiazepine therapy as needed.
Recheck serum potassium and replace as needed to maintain normokalemia.
Monitor renal function with serial creatinine and urine output; avoid nephrotoxins and adjust medication doses for renal impairment.
Assess and manage agitation and anxiety with nonpharmacologic measures and antipsychotic therapy as needed.
Perform fall precautions: bed rest with assistance, call light within reach, and non-skid footwear.
Perform pressure ulcer prevention: reposition every 2 hours, keep skin clean and dry, and use pressure-relieving mattress.
Provide pain management with acetaminophen as needed, reassessing pain level.
Encourage incentive spirometry and early mobilization as tolerated to prevent pulmonary complications.
